title: Experimental evidence for the influence of group size on cultural complexity.
central_claims: Larger groups better maintain cultural complexity and diversity in a dual-task cultural-transmission game.

source_manifest.title: Camerer et al. SSRP supplementary methods and Tables 1, 3 and 4
source_manifest.finding: Larger groups maintained cultural diversity in the replication: r=.361, p=.003, 65 group observations/482 participants. Interpretation of broader demographic causation remains debated.

source_manifest.title: Group size and cultural complexity
source_manifest.finding: Andersson and Read challenge the demographic interpretation using a reanalysis; this is contrary evidence, not independent confirmation.

source_manifest.title: Derex et al. reply
source_manifest.finding: Original authors defend the interpretation and distinguish persistence, improvement and cultural richness.
